name: stickie
description: Not another Editor — Notes for Agents. Local review surface for agent-made changes.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @stickie/client build && pnpm --filter @stickie/server build && pnpm --filter @stickie/desktop build
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm build && node desktop/scripts/stage.mjs && pnpm --filter @stickie/desktop exec electron-builder --config electron-builder.json
